summary: The PR addresses the issue of non-ASCII domain names in email headers by converting them to punycode. However, there are some minor concerns regarding style and potential behavioral regression.

issues.description: The new `reproduce.py` script does not follow the typical testing conventions of Django, which uses `unittest` or `pytest`. It could be better integrated into the existing test framework.
The change might introduce behavioral regression if other parts of the code rely on the original ASCII-only behavior of `socket.getfqdn()`. This needs further investigation.
